description: A photograph depicting several black and white dairy cows grazing on an improved grassland pasture under an overcast sky. In the foreground, a water channel or ditch is visible, with tall green grasses along its bank, separating the viewer from the main pasture. Five cows are visible: one stands prominently in the mid-ground facing the viewer, two are grazing further back to the right, and two more are near the distant treeline. In the background, beyond a line of trees and shrubs, farm buildings with dark roofs are partially visible, consistent with agricultural settings. The land cover is predominantly green grassland. The image is attributed to "© European Union, 2013" and is identified as "LUCAS".
